highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh flush and GPU-buffer upload failure handling.

bullets.lead: Failed GPU work does not proceed with stale buffers
bullets.detail: Propagates render-task, flush, and submission failures and rejects incomplete uploads under memory pressure. Affected draws are dropped; the existing managed flush operations remain void.

bullets.lead: Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BinSkim BA2007
bullets.detail: Consumers no longer need to baseline the disabled-critical-warnings error in libHarfBuzzSharp.dll. The native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected.

harfbuzz_summary: The Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 by scoping vendored-source warning suppression. The bundled HarfBuzz engine and exported ABI are unchanged.

v4.152.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh flush and GPU-buffer upload failure handling.
